featuredSupporters.name: Padma Shri Dr. Sou. Sindhutai Sapakal (Maai)
featuredSupporters.title: Mother of Orphans
featuredSupporters.blurb1: A soul out of life's hardship was born as Mother to over a thousand children and devoted her entire life to social service. After 70 years of lifespan (Born: 1948 - Died: 2022), she raised a grand family of 220 sons-in-laws, 50 daughters-in-laws.
featuredSupporters.blurb2: She adopted more than 1200 orphaned children and provided them food, shelter, and education. She was honored with Padma Shri in 2021.

featuredSupporters.name: Mamata Tai Sapakal
featuredSupporters.title: Carrying the Legacy
featuredSupporters.blurb1: Mamata Tai has stood beside Maai's mission for decades, guiding and nurturing generations of children with warmth and resolve.
featuredSupporters.blurb2: She continues to expand the family and strengthen institutions that care for the underprivileged.

featuredSupporters.name: Sanmati Support Circle
featuredSupporters.title: Community of Care
featuredSupporters.blurb1: A collective of well-wishers who support education, shelter, and daily needs across Maai's institutions.
featuredSupporters.blurb2: Their consistent involvement helps build stable homes and opportunities for every child.

featuredSupporters.name: Gopika Initiative
featuredSupporters.title: Future Builders
featuredSupporters.blurb1: Focused on empowering girls through education and mentorship, inspired by Maai's lifelong commitment.
featuredSupporters.blurb2: The initiative nurtures leadership, confidence, and self-reliance.
